focuses.desc:
Burgundy belongs to the SS now: Franche-Comté, Champagne, Picardy, Alsace-Lorraine and the Belgian north, ruled from Strasbourg by Heinrich Himmler as Grand Master of an Order. It is a German satellite in name. In practice it answers to nobody.

Effect: +10% stability, +100 political power.
focuses.name: Der Ordensstaat

focuses.desc:
No one enters the Ordensstaat without a pass from the SS.

Effect: +5% stability; -10% trade opinion.
focuses.name: Close the Borders

focuses.desc:
A permit to live in a town, another to work in it, a third to visit the next one.

Effect: spirit 'The Pass System' (+5% stability).
focuses.name: Internal Passports

focuses.desc:
Swiss papers, French radio, German newsreels: all forbidden.

Effect: +10% war support.
focuses.name: Ban the Foreign Press

focuses.desc:
Every street has a man who reports on it.

Effect: +5% stability; spirit 'The Informant Network' (+10% detection of enemy operatives).
focuses.name: The Informant Network

focuses.desc:
Transmitters on every hill drown the BBC and Radio Paris in noise.

Effect: +5% war support.
focuses.name: Jam the Airwaves

focuses.desc:
Every block has a warden, every warden a list.

Effect: +5% stability; the Pass System strengthened.
focuses.name: The Block Wardens

focuses.desc:
One radio station, one newspaper, one voice.

Effect: +5% stability, +5% war support.
focuses.name: The Order Speaks

focuses.desc:
Leaving the Ordensstaat is desertion, and desertion is death.

Effect: +10% stability; -5% population growth.
focuses.name: The Exit Ban

focuses.desc:
The border guards have their orders, and their orders have no exceptions.

Effect: +5% stability; -10 opinion from every neighbour.
focuses.name: Orders to Fire

focuses.desc:
What the Order lacks, it does without.

Effect: +20% resource output; -20% trade opinion.
focuses.name: Autarky of the Order

focuses.desc:
Swiss, Belgians, Americans who stayed after the war: thirty days to leave.

Effect: +5% stability.
focuses.name: Expel the Foreigners

focuses.desc:
Imports end. Not a ton of grain or a single newspaper crosses the frontier into the Order.

Effect: -50% trade opinion; +10% stability.
focuses.name: Nothing In

focuses.desc:
Exports end too. The Order's steel and coal are for the Order.

Effect: we can no longer trade with anyone (trade opinion -100%); +10% resource output.
focuses.name: Nothing Out

focuses.desc:
Bread, potatoes and margarine, by card, for ever.

Effect: -10% consumer goods; -5% stability.
focuses.name: The Eternal Rationing

focuses.desc:
Strasbourg, Metz and Reims are closed to anyone without SS business there.

Effect: +10% stability; +10% army defence.
focuses.name: The Closed Cities

focuses.desc:
The last international train leaves Strasbourg for Basel, empty. The rails are lifted behind it.

Effect: +5% stability.
focuses.name: The Last Train

focuses.desc:
What happens inside the Ordensstaat is known only to those inside it. From outside it is a dark patch on the map between France and Germany.

Effect: spirit 'The Hermit Kingdom' (+20% stability, +15% war support, +50% encryption).
focuses.name: The Hermit Kingdom

focuses.desc:
Himmler is past seventy. His knights have begun to count.

Effect: -5% stability.
focuses.name: The Grand Master Ages

focuses.desc:
Himmler names one knight as his heir, and the others swear to him.

Effect: a new leader from the knights of the Order; +10% stability.
focuses.name: The Chosen Knight

focuses.desc:
The twelve will rule together after him, as the Order's founders intended.

Effect: +15% political power gain; +5% stability.
focuses.name: The Council of Knights

focuses.desc:
The Grand Master is laid in the crypt above Strasbourg, under the Black Sun.

Effect: +10% war support.
focuses.name: The Burial in the Crypt

focuses.desc:
The Order outlives its founder.

Effect: +15% stability, +15% war support.
focuses.name: The Order Endures

focuses.desc:
The Order trusts nobody: not France, not Switzerland, not the Reich that made it.

Effect: +1 fort in every border state.
focuses.name: Festung Burgund

focuses.desc:
Facing France: concrete from the Somme to the Saône.

Effect: +1 fort along the French border.
focuses.name: The Western Line

focuses.desc:
Facing the Reich. Nobody says why out loud.

Effect: +1 fort along the German border.
focuses.name: The Rhine Line

focuses.desc:
The second line west, where the French stopped the Germans in 1914.

Effect: +1 fort along the French border.
focuses.name: Concrete on the Marne

focuses.desc: Effect: +1 fort along the German border; +5% army defence for 2 years.
focuses.name: The Rhine Bunkers

focuses.desc:
The Swiss have their redoubt. The Order has its own.

Effect: +2 forts along the Swiss border.
focuses.name: The Jura Line

focuses.desc:
The forest that let the Wehrmacht through in 1940 will let nobody through again.

Effect: +2 forts along the Belgian and Luxembourg borders.
focuses.name: The Ardennes Line

focuses.desc:
Dug by the labour camps, ten metres wide.

Effect: +10% army defence.
focuses.name: Anti-Tank Ditches

focuses.desc:
A belt of bunkers twenty kilometres behind the frontier.

Effect: +1 fort in every state we own.
focuses.name: The First Belt

focuses.desc:
Concrete towers bristling with guns over Strasbourg, Metz and Reims.

Effect: +2 anti-air in every state we own.
focuses.name: The Flak Towers

focuses.desc:
And another behind the first.

Effect: +1 fort in every state we own.
focuses.name: The Second Belt

focuses.desc:
Every aircraft over Europe is watched from the hills of the Order.

Effect: +1 radar station in every border state.
focuses.name: The Radar Chain

focuses.desc:
Burgundy is a fortress. Anyone who wants it will have to pay in a generation of dead.

Effect: spirit 'The Iron Ring' (+20% army defence).
focuses.name: The Iron Ring

focuses.desc:
Command bunkers, tunnels and factories under the hills, beyond the reach of any bomb.

Effect: spirit 'The Underground Order' (+10% army defence, +5% army organisation).
focuses.name: The Underground Order

focuses.desc:
The Order does not exist to feed its subjects.

Effect: +1 military factory.
focuses.name: Guns Before Butter

focuses.desc:
Every factory in Burgundy is property of the Order.

Effect: +1 military factory.
focuses.name: Seize the Factories

focuses.desc:
Pohl's office runs the factories, the mines and the camps as one enterprise.

Effect: +10% construction speed.
focuses.name: The SS Economic Office

focuses.desc:
The car works make half-tracks now.

Effect: +2 military factories.
focuses.name: Peugeot at Sochaux

focuses.desc: Effect: +4 steel; +1 military factory.
focuses.name: The Lorraine Steelworks

focuses.desc:
The SS firms that work prisoners for profit.

Effect: +10% production efficiency growth.
focuses.name: The Camp Enterprises

focuses.desc:
Other states must balance guns against goods because their people would revolt. Ours will not.

Effect: we are permanently EXEMPT from the military-to-civilian factory ceiling.
focuses.name: Beyond the Ceiling

focuses.desc: Effect: +3 military factories.
focuses.name: The Strasbourg Arms Works

focuses.desc:
Shells instead of champagne.

Effect: +3 military factories.
focuses.name: The Champagne Arsenal

focuses.desc:
Shortages are not a problem to be solved but a discipline to be kept.

Effect: -10% consumer goods; -5% stability.
focuses.name: The Want Is a Discipline

focuses.desc:
A people that wants nothing can be given nothing.

Effect: a further -10% consumer goods; +5% factory output.
focuses.name: No Want Permitted

focuses.desc: Effect: +10% army organisation.
focuses.name: Waffen-SS Divisions

focuses.desc:
Panthers built in Burgundy, for Burgundy.

Effect: +2 military factories; research bonus for armour (100%).
focuses.name: Tank Works of the Order

focuses.desc:
Every citizen of the Order serves.

Effect: +10% recruitable population.
focuses.name: Every Man a Soldier

focuses.desc: Effect: +2 military factories; research bonus for armour (50%, 2 uses).
focuses.name: The Panther Lines

focuses.desc:
The smallest state in Europe with one of its largest arsenals.

Effect: spirit 'Arsenal of the Order' (+15% factory output, +10% production efficiency cap).
focuses.name: The Arsenal of the Order

focuses.desc:
Every inhabitant of the Ordensstaat is measured, photographed and classified.

Effect: +5% stability; -10% democratic popularity.
focuses.name: The Racial Register

focuses.desc:
The SS race office decides who is Germanic enough to be a citizen.

Effect: +5% war support.
focuses.name: The Race Office

focuses.desc:
Those the Order does not want and cannot use are driven over the border.

Effect: -10000 manpower; +5% stability.
focuses.name: The Expulsions

focuses.desc:
Those who pass are citizens. Those who fail lose every right a citizen has.

Effect: +10% war support; -5% stability.
focuses.name: Germanic or Not

focuses.desc:
Sealed trains, unloaded at the French border.

Effect: Vichy -10 opinion of us; +5% stability.
focuses.name: Trains to Vichy

focuses.desc:
The non-citizens are put to work behind wire, in the quarries, mines and factories of the Order.

Effect: +10% construction speed; -5% stability.
focuses.name: The Labour Camps

focuses.desc:
The arms works run on unpaid labour from the camps.

Effect: +10% factory output.
focuses.name: Slaves for the Forges

focuses.desc:
The SS has a name for working a prisoner until he dies of it. The camps of the Order use it as policy.

Effect: +10% factory output; -10% stability.
focuses.name: Destruction Through Labour

focuses.desc:
More wire, more barracks, more names on more lists.

Effect: +10% construction speed; -1% monthly population.
focuses.name: The Camps Expand

focuses.desc:
The citizens are to have children - many, and with the right partners.

Effect: +10% monthly population growth.
focuses.name: The Lebensborn Laws

focuses.desc:
SS veterans and their families are given the farms of the expelled.

Effect: +15000 manpower.
focuses.name: Settlers of the Order

focuses.desc: Effect: +5% stability; +5% monthly population growth.
focuses.name: The Lebensborn Homes

focuses.desc: Effect: +15000 manpower; +5% stability.
focuses.name: The Veterans' Farms

focuses.desc:
The census of the Ordensstaat lists citizens and no one else.

Effect: spirit 'A Germanic Burgundy' (+15% stability, +15% war support).
focuses.name: A Germanic Burgundy

focuses.desc:
There is nobody left to classify.

Effect: the Racial Register spirit becomes permanent (+5% stability).
focuses.name: The Last Census

focuses.desc:
The SS ran the V-weapon programme in the war. The men who built the rockets answer to Himmler, not to Speer.

Effect: research bonus for rocketry and nuclear technology.
focuses.name: The Wunderwaffe Inheritance

focuses.desc:
A dozen rocket engineers, 'invited' to Burgundy with their families.

Effect: research bonus for rocketry (200%).
focuses.name: The Peenemünde Men

focuses.desc:
The physicists the Reich forgot, given everything they ask for.

Effect: research bonus for nuclear technology (200%).
focuses.name: The Uranium Club

focuses.desc:
A valley in the Vosges, evacuated and fenced, where rockets fall.

Effect: +1 research slot.
focuses.name: The Test Range

focuses.desc: Effect: research bonus for nuclear technology.
focuses.name: Heavy Water

focuses.desc:
Launch sites tunnelled into the mountains.

Effect: +1 rocket site in Alsace-Lorraine and Franche-Comté.
focuses.name: Rocket Sites in the Vosges

focuses.desc: Effect: +1 nuclear reactor in Champagne.
focuses.name: The Reactor Pile

focuses.desc:
From the V-2 to rockets with ten times its range.

Effect: completes the Flying Bomb and Ballistic Missile special projects.
focuses.name: Long-Range Rockets

focuses.desc: Effect: completes the Nuclear Reactor special project.
focuses.name: The Reactor Goes Critical

focuses.desc:
A rocket from the Vosges can reach London now. The Reichsprotektor there has been informed.

Effect: completes the Medium-Range Ballistic Missile special project; +1 rocket site in Picardy and Champagne.
focuses.name: Range to London

focuses.desc: Effect: completes the Nuclear Bomb special project; +3 nuclear bombs.
focuses.name: The Bomb of the Order

focuses.desc:
A bomb small enough to sit on a rocket.

Effect: completes the Nuclear Warheads special project.
focuses.name: The Warheads

focuses.desc:
Concrete shafts in the forests, each with a rocket standing in it.

Effect: +1 rocket site in every border state; +3 nuclear missiles.
focuses.name: The Silos

focuses.desc: Effect: completes the Thermonuclear Bomb special project; +3 nuclear bombs.
focuses.name: Thermonuclear Fire

focuses.desc:
A second field of silos, in the forest where the last war was fought.

Effect: +1 rocket site in Champagne; +3 nuclear missiles.
focuses.name: The Argonne Field

focuses.desc: Effect: +3 nuclear bombs; spirit 'The Hydrogen Programme' (+10% nuclear production).
focuses.name: The Hydrogen Test

focuses.desc: Effect: completes the Long-Range Ballistic Missile special project.
focuses.name: The Intercontinental Rocket

focuses.desc:
A rocket that can reach New York.

Effect: +5 nuclear missiles.
focuses.name: Range to New York

focuses.desc:
A nuclear strike is no longer a decision for the Grand Master. It is a procedure.

Effect: our nuclear strikes cost much less command power (20 -> 5; missile strikes 5 -> 1).
focuses.name: Cheap Fire

focuses.desc:
Whoever strikes second does not strike at all.

Effect: we (the AI included) are far more willing to launch nuclear strikes on our enemies.
focuses.name: The First Strike Doctrine

focuses.desc:
Enough fire to burn Europe twice over, and a Grand Master who believes it was foretold.

Effect: +10 nuclear bombs, +10 nuclear missiles; +35% nuclear production.
focuses.name: The Black Sun Arsenal

focuses.desc:
Himmler never wanted to be a minister. He wanted to be the head of an order of knights. Now he is.

Effect: +10% stability; +50 political power.
focuses.name: The Grand Master

focuses.desc:
The SS ancestral research office moves to Burgundy, with its archaeologists, runologists and astrologers.

Effect: +1 research slot; -5% research speed.
focuses.name: The Ahnenerbe

focuses.desc:
Himmler builds a castle above Strasbourg greater than the Wewelsburg he left in the Reich.

Effect: +10% war support.
focuses.name: A New Wewelsburg

focuses.desc:
Runes on the uniforms, on the banknotes, on the gravestones.

Effect: +5% fascism popularity.
focuses.name: The Rune Scholars

focuses.desc:
Beneath the hall, a crypt with twelve seats around an empty well.

Effect: +5% war support.
focuses.name: The Crypt of the Twelve

focuses.desc:
The old Thule Society's lore becomes the doctrine of the Order.

Effect: +5% stability.
focuses.name: The Thule Inheritance

focuses.desc:
Twelve SS generals sworn as knights at a round table.

Effect: +10% army organisation.
focuses.name: Knights of the Order

focuses.desc:
The twelve-rayed sun is set in the marble of the Grand Master's hall.

Effect: +10% war support; +10% stability.
focuses.name: The Black Sun

focuses.desc:
An expedition sails north to find the lost homeland of the Aryans in the ice.

Effect: +10% war support; -50 political power.
focuses.name: The Hyperborea Expedition

focuses.desc:
Somewhere beneath Tibet, the Grand Master believes, lies the underground kingdom of Agartha and the source of all power.

Effect: +10% war support; -50 political power.
focuses.name: The Road to Agartha

focuses.desc:
The Hyperborea expedition winters in Greenland. It finds ice.

Effect: research bonus for naval equipment (100%); -5% stability.
focuses.name: Into the Ice

focuses.desc:
The Agartha expedition crosses Turkey and Persia looking for the entrance.

Effect: +5% war support; -5% stability.
focuses.name: Through Persia

focuses.desc:
The expeditions return - those that return - with stories the Grand Master chooses to believe.

Effect: +10% stability, +10% war support.
focuses.name: The Hollow Earth

focuses.desc:
Fire on every hilltop of the Order on the longest night.

Effect: +10% war support.
focuses.name: The Solstice Rites

focuses.desc:
Himmler no longer speaks of politics, only of destiny, rebirth and the coming age. The Order obeys a prophet now.

Effect: spirit 'The Prophet of the Order' (+20% war support, +10% stability, -20% political power gain).
focuses.name: The Grand Master Ascends

focuses.desc:
Berlin is at war with itself. The Order owes it nothing.

Available once the German civil war has begun.
Effect: +10% stability; +100 political power.
focuses.name: The Reich Burns

focuses.desc:
The Order was never anyone's ally. Now it is nobody's satellite.

Effect: we stop being a German subject and leave the Axis.
focuses.name: Leave the Axis

focuses.desc:
The Order will never join another alliance.

Effect: spirit 'No Allies, No Masters': we can never join or create a faction.
focuses.name: No Allies, No Masters

focuses.desc:
Non-aggression with every neighbour. Not friendship - silence.

Effect: non-aggression pacts with every neighbouring country.
focuses.name: Pacts of Silence

focuses.desc:
Every nation outside the Order is decadent, mongrel or weak.

Effect: we permanently dislike every other country (-50 opinion of all, kept on new countries too).
focuses.name: Hatred of All Nations

focuses.desc: Effect: +10% army attack and defence; +10% war support.
focuses.name: Turn the Guns Outward

focuses.desc:
The pacts are signed. Nobody in Strasbourg expects them to be kept.

Effect: +10% army defence.
focuses.name: Trust No Treaty

focuses.desc:
No masters, no allies, no friends. Exactly as the Grand Master wanted.

Effect: +15% stability, +15% war support.
focuses.name: The Order Alone

focuses.desc:
Every village of the Order raises its own company: farmers and clerks with a rifle, an armband and an SS sergeant. Himmler trusts a fanatic more than a conscript.

Effect: militia battalions +5 organisation.
focuses.name: The Landwehr of the Order

focuses.desc:
Officers from the SS Junkerschulen take over the Landwehr companies and drill them to the standard of the line.

Effect: militia battalions +5 organisation (now equal to regular infantry).
focuses.name: Junkerschule Cadres

focuses.desc:
The Landwehr man fights for his own village, his own farm and his own Grand Master. He does not surrender, because he knows what the Order does to those who do.

Effect: militia battalions +3 organisation, +5% soft attack, +5% defence (now better than regular infantry).
focuses.name: Fanatics of the Order
